staff.name: Tatiana Mclaughlin
staff.description:
My name is Tatiana Mclaughlin.  
I am the proud owner of Get Naked wax bar. I have 15 plus years of experience under my belt. I love being able to educate while giving my clients the best experience. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to message. To book, download Booksy.

reviews.author: Ladricka G…
reviews.body: Very professional and great customer service! If you want an excellent waxing service provider, book her ASAP!!

reviews.author: Donald T…
reviews.body: She was very kind, knowledgeable fast. It was almost painless and this being my first time I was extremely comfortable and 100% satisfied with the outcome. I recommend it and I am now a permanent customer.

reviews.author: John P…
reviews.body: I had an appointment to get my eyebrows and ears waxed on 5/1/26. I added a nose wax in person. Tatiana was professional and personable. She makes one feel very comfortable almost immediately. Service was quick and relatively painless. Tatiana extremely knowledgeable about skin situations and medications/treatments that can affect the waxing process. Highly recommend.
